southern_paddy_road.label: Monsoon paddy on the march north to Colachel
southern_paddy_road.anchor: Flooded monsoon paddy in southern Travancore crossed by a narrow raised village bund, coconut and palmyra palms along the field edges, low thatched and tiled village houses on laterite footings and the Western Ghats foothills lost in cloud. The Travancore column hauls iron cannon on wooden carriages with bullocks and ropes through ankle-deep mud, Nair infantry and riders strung out along the bund.
southern_paddy_road.absent: No blue-coated soldiers, ships, forts or stone buildings; no paved road or stone bridge; no turbans on the Nair infantry.
southern_paddy_road.time: grey monsoon daylight under a heavy sky

sealing_table_memory.label: Sealing of the Elayadathu pact, remembered
sealing_table_memory.anchor: A tight view of a dark polished timber table top: a single sheet of paper covered in faint, indistinct marks, a pool of red sealing wax and a small brass seal. A Dutch hand in a blue coat cuff holds the paper flat while a mature woman's lightly lined hand with gold bangles presses the seal, both hands in the right two thirds of the frame.
sealing_table_memory.absent: No faces, full figures or room view; no legible writing, numerals, monogram, coat of arms or seal design.

burned_shore_memory.label: Colachel fishing shore after the shelling, remembered
burned_shore_memory.anchor: The Colachel fishing shore: a curve of grey sand below coconut palms, the charred frames of palm-thatched fishermen's huts with blackened thatch, and plank canoes and log rafts turned upside down on the sand. Far out on the grey water, three small Dutch East Indiamen lie at anchor under plain red, white and blue flags, low smoke drifting from their gun ports.
burned_shore_memory.absent: No people, no bodies, no stone fort or harbour wall on the shore; no monogram, emblem or lettering on any flag.

kottar_street_memory.label: Occupied village street near Kottar, remembered
kottar_street_memory.anchor: A packed-earth village street near Kottar between low houses with laterite walls, timber-post verandahs and palm-thatch or tiled roofs, coconut palms behind. Dutch East India Company soldiers in blue coats sit at ease on one verandah beside stacked muskets, a plain red, white and blue flag hangs from its eave, and villagers in white cloth watch in silence from their doorways.
kottar_street_memory.absent: No fighting, no European buildings or fort; no monogram, emblem or lettering on the flag or the coats.

siege_lines.label: Travancore siege lines before Colachel
siege_lines.anchor: Travancore earthwork trenches and gun batteries curve in a closing ring round the Dutch beachhead on the sandy Colachel shore, parapets revetted with palm trunks and woven palm-leaf mats, iron guns on wooden carriages, coconut palms and sea scrub behind. Across open sand stands the Dutch stockade, sagging mud ramparts topped by a timber palisade with canvas tents and rough huts inside, and the grey sea at its back.
siege_lines.absent: No masonry star fort, dressed stone bastions or European town; no barbed wire or sandbag walls; no British red coats; no lettering or monogram on any flag, crate or barrel.
siege_lines.time: hard coastal daylight, heat haze and salt spray

inland_scrub.label: Inland scrub behind the Dutch beachhead
inland_scrub.anchor: Dry sandy scrub inland from the Colachel shore: thorn bushes, low palmyra and coconut palms and red earth tracks winding through the brush. The patrol is light Maravar horse on small, quick mounts with lances.
inland_scrub.absent: No village, fort, ships or trenches in view; no Madurai or Deccan riders in this patrol.

night_surf.label: Colachel surf at night
night_surf.anchor: The open Colachel beach at night, far from the batteries: wet black sand, a heaving black surf and monsoon cloud over a hidden moon. The Mukkuvar fishermen's low, narrow plank boats are blackened with soot, and the men are oiled and bare-chested in loincloths.
night_surf.absent: No ships, lanterns or lights on the water; no batteries, tents or stockade in view; no glass lantern on the shore.
night_surf.time: night, faint moonlight through monsoon cloud

offshore_anchorage.label: Dutch ship at anchor off Colachel
offshore_anchorage.anchor: At the waterline far offshore: the towering black hull of a three-masted, square-rigged 18th-century Dutch East Indiaman at anchor, its high stern and gunport strake catching faint moonlight. Its heavy hemp anchor cable runs down into the black swell.
offshore_anchorage.absent: No flag emblem, monogram, lettering or ship's name; no crowd on a lit deck, no shore in view, no rowing boats.
offshore_anchorage.time: night, faint moonlight on black swell

command_awning.label: Camp awning behind the Travancore lines
command_awning.anchor: A cloth awning on bamboo poles in the Travancore camp behind the siege lines, woven mats on the sand, palm-leaf bundles spread on a mat and a brass open-wick oil lamp on the ground. Varma's camp stool is a low seat of plain local timber, and beyond the awning's edge the distant enemy campfires glow in the dark.
command_awning.absent: No European chair, table or tent furniture, no throne, no glass lantern.
command_awning.time: evening, warm low light from a single brass oil lamp

karl_drawing_memory.label: Karl August's palm-leaf drawing, remembered
karl_drawing_memory.anchor: The stone floor of the small limewashed room in the Travancore compound from chapter 11, where a palm leaf lies flat. A pale hand with a sickly yellow cast and a rough cotton cuff draws on it in charcoal: a wavering coastline, a small square and one shaded corner, as plain lines.
karl_drawing_memory.absent: No face or full figure, no table, desk or stool under the leaf, no legible writing or numerals on the leaf.
karl_drawing_memory.time: low slanting evening light from the narrow courtyard

dutch_camp_interior.label: Inside the Dutch camp at Colachel
dutch_camp_interior.anchor: The heart of the Dutch camp inside the stockade: canvas tents, rough huts and a small, old stone church with a tiled roof, used as the powder store, wooden powder barrels stacked in its doorway beside sacks of rice. The garrison are Dutch East India Company soldiers in blue coats.
dutch_camp_interior.absent: No tall spire or European town around it; no lettering, monogram or marks on barrels, sacks or flags; no British red coats.
dutch_camp_interior.time: hard daylight under a blue sky

sortie_ground.label: Open sand between the trenches and the burning stockade
sortie_ground.anchor: The open sand and trampled scrub between the Travancore forward trench and the burning Dutch stockade, smoke rolling across it, where Dutch East India Company infantry in blue and grey coats form a square with fixed bayonets against the Nair line of round shields, swords and spears. The allied horse are Madurai lancers in knee-length white jamas and high white turbans with long bamboo lances, Deccan riders in off-white turbans and light Maravar horse; only Nagoji wears the rust-red turban and red sash.
sortie_ground.absent: No blood or close-up bodies, no green turbans, no second rust-red turban or red sash, no turban on any Nair, no British red coats, no lettering on flags.
sortie_ground.time: afternoon glare through smoke and flame

palm_grove_flank.label: Palm grove on the left flank
palm_grove_flank.anchor: A grove of tall coconut palms in deep shade on a slight rise at the left flank, sandy ground and low scrub, looking down and across open ground at smoke over the Dutch square. The waiting horsemen are light Maravar riders without Ponnan's red shoulder cloth, Madurai lancers in knee-length white jamas and high white turbans with long bamboo lances, and Deccan riders in off-white turbans; only Nagoji wears the rust-red turban and red sash.
palm_grove_flank.absent: No green turbans, no second rust-red turban or red sash, no pennons on the lances, no British red coats.
palm_grove_flank.time: deep shade under the palms against smoky glare beyond

surrender_beach.label: Colachel beach below the burned stockade
surrender_beach.anchor: The wide Colachel beach below the burned-down Dutch stockade, its timber palisade reduced to glowing embers and smoke drifting low over the sand. Dutch survivors in ash-stained blue coats huddle on the sand under guard of Nair spearmen in white mundus, and when the sea is in view the Dutch ships are only small, distant shapes.
surrender_beach.absent: No blood or bodies, no ropes at any prisoner's neck, no turban on any Nair, no British red coats, no lettering on flags.
surrender_beach.time: sunset in lurid purples and reds through smoke

character_notes.nagoji: Thick curled moustache; clean-shaven chin and jaw, smooth skin, no beard, stubble or facial scar, even under mud, smoke and night. A tiny flush gold ear stud on the lobe with nothing hanging from it; long curly black hair with no grey yet, and sleeves down to the wrists so the old marks on the inner LEFT forearm stay hidden.
character_notes.kayal: Bay mare with an ochre red-brown coat, black mane, tail and lower legs and no white markings; taller than Ponnan's Maravar horse, smaller than a Madurai charger.
character_notes.dhanaji: Stockier and a little shorter than Nagoji, short black beard, white Maratha pagdi, indigo quilted tunic, no sash, talwar, on a brown horse; never a rust-red turban or red sash.
character_notes.ponnan: Bare-headed with curly hair uncovered, broad-shouldered Maravar, thick moustache and clean chin, red shoulder cloth, short jacket, white mundu hitched above bare knees; on a smaller, lighter Maravar horse a head lower than Nagoji.
character_notes.ramayyan: Older, thin, sharp fine features and receding hair, bare-headed, no jewellery, no forehead marks or sacred thread. Plain white cloth in camp; in battle and after it a mud-splattered white dhoti and a curved Nair sword with no shield.
character_notes.varma: Face, moustache and build from his sheet, with black hair, never the grey of the sheet's later figure, and never a crown. On campaign and on the beach he wears the cream-and-gold turban, cream-and-gold cloth and gold necklaces; only in the Tiruvattar inset is he bare-headed, hair in a side knot above the LEFT ear, bare-chested in a plain white cloth and barefoot, with no turban, crest or shoulder dressing.
character_notes.eustachius: The only tall, pale-haired Dutchman, bareheaded so the pale hair reads, in a Dutch blue coat; every other Dutch officer is shorter and dark-haired. At the perimeter he is too far for a face; at the surrender his coat is torn and soot-stained.
character_notes.karl: Hand only: pale skin with a sickly yellow cast and a rough cotton shirt cuff, holding a stick of charcoal; no face or figure.
character_notes.savitri: Hand only in this chapter: a mature woman's lightly lined hand with gold bangles; her face is never shown.
